Synopsis:
    Prince Harry, Meghan, and their two children have returned to the UK after six years in California. The move is unofficial — they will not hold royal duties or live in a royal residence. Motivations appear mixed: personal (Harry's proximity to cancer-stricken King Charles), and possibly financial (US business ventures reportedly struggling). Family tensions with Prince William and senior royals persist. Meghan's potential acting comeback was reported then denied. A concurrent London court ruling exposes Harry to significant legal liability toward the Daily Mail's publisher.
